title: Use the composite order index
summary: Write a customer and date-range query that uses a composite index instead of scanning the orders table.
objectives: Read an EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN result and identify an index search.
Align a query predicate and sort order with a composite index.
Avoid a full table scan for a selective customer and date range.
constraints: Return exactly the columns id, ordered_at, and total_cents in that order.
Return only orders for customer_id 42 with ordered_at on or after 2026-01-01.
The query plan must use the idx_orders_customer_date index and must not scan the orders table.

examples.explanation: The composite index covers the customer filter and the date range.

public.name: Customer 42 after the cutoff
public.description: Returns the matching orders using the composite index.

hidden.name: Cutoff boundary
hidden.description: An order one day before the cutoff must be excluded.

hidden.name: Other customers excluded
hidden.description: Orders for other customers must not appear.

hidden.description: The query still uses the index when no rows match.
